name: ai-multi-instance
description: Local dashboard for running Claude Code, Codex, Cursor Agent, and custom CLI sessions in parallel with tmux persistence

scripts.dev: node scripts/with-writable-tmpdir.mjs concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: node scripts/with-writable-tmpdir.mjs npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
